name: sonic-lessons-page
step: v12-flight 9: lessons passed end to end in the real page by a scripted keyboard pilot
voice: the engine says nothing (my screen reader speaks, speed 2): it waits the time a line takes
note: headless Chrome runs muted (--mute-audio); how anything sounds is not judged here

captionLines: Is this sound in front of you or behind you? Press 1 for in front, 2 for behind, 3 if you are not sure.
Your headphones work well. You are ready for the next step.
Lesson passed. Next, a bit harder: Meet the sounds.
Escape: menu. Z: repeat the task. N: next.
A square gate has four bars. Its sound ticks at each corner.
Lesson passed. Next, a bit harder: A series of squares.
Lesson passed. Next, a bit harder: Rings in a line.
You held your height. That is the first skill of flying by ear.
Lesson passed. Next, a bit harder: Turn toward a sound.

checks.name: the pause menu offers Fly by Sound; its item shows the start screen over the flight (flight paused), Escape closes it and the flight goes on

the motor sound in the mode (v0.13: on by default): the graph is on the engine's own context from the start (one AudioContext, master over 0); the speaker button's first press turns it off (master 0), the second on again (master over 0), the output a little louder with the motors (they play under the cues) and its peak under the limiter's ceiling (0.5013)

the sound follows the frames: the height tone sounds (RMS over 1e-3), is silent while the flight is paused behind the start screen (RMS under 3e-4 and 20 times under the tone: setLayers none, only the motors' floor is left), and is back when the flight goes on
